<!-- Where the compendium ends up (the DOI that Zenodo or Dryad gives you when
     you upload data_and_code.zip), and how the analysis can be re-run. This is
     also where infrastructure gets cited -- renv, and the scaffold this
     project was built with -- NOT in Methods among the packages that produced
     the results. Cite here only what a reader can actually resolve: a package
     with no public repository and no DOI is better left unmentioned. Example:

     Data and code are archived at Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX). The
     analysis environment is recorded in `renv.lock` and can be restored with
     renv [@R-renv]; the project structure was generated with easypaper
     [@R-easypaper].

     deposit_zenodo() uploads data_and_code.zip as a Zenodo draft, reserves
     its DOI and writes it wherever the text says 10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX.

     A double-blind submission moves this section to the title page. -->
